releases.name: v2.0.0
releases.body:
The first release of the example extension for the Freelens extension API v2. It needs Freelens 2.0.0 or newer; v1.10.2 stays the release for Freelens 1.x.

The repository is the reference template for building, type-checking, testing and releasing a Freelens v2 extension. The Freelens extension docs (`docs/extensions/` in freelensapp/freelens) define the API contract and point here for the rest; `AGENTS.md` explains every pattern and why it is there.

## Breaking changes

* Requires Freelens `^2.0.0` (`engines.freelens`) and Node.js 24 (`engines.node: >= 24.0.0`).
* `dist/main.js` and `dist/renderer.js` are ES modules (`"type": "module"`), built by two Vite library-mode runs instead of electron-vite. The renderer CSS is extracted to `dist/renderer.css`.
* The stack follows Freelens 2.0.0: React 19.3, mobx 7 with mobx-react 10 (standard decorators only, `@observable accessor`), TypeScript 7, Vite 8, Vitest 5, Electron 44, pnpm 12.

| Library                   | v1.10.2   | v2.0.0 |
| ------------------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `@freelensapp/extensions` | `^1.10.2` | 2.0.0  |
| react, react-dom          | 17.0.2    | 19.3.1 |
| mobx                      | 6.13.7    | 7.0.6  |
| mobx-react                | 7.6.0     | 10.0.2 |
| typescript                | 5.9.3     | 7.0.2  |
| vitest                    | `^4.1.9`  | 5.0.5  |
| node                      | 22        | 24     |
| pnpm                      | 10.34.4   | 12.15.0 |

## What's Changed

### Extension API v2

* Migrate the build stack and shared sources to the Freelens v2 extension API by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/328
* Adapt the Example feature to the Freelens v2 extension API by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/336
* Re-render the available version page when the host serves a version by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/353
* Register the Example models in customResources by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/364
* Register details and menu items with the typed helpers of the extension API by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/368
* Keep a render error of the extension inside its page, panel or menu item by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/370

### Build and type check

* Write the CSS module declarations with a plugin that cannot leave one empty by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/344
* Check for unused files with knip by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/349
* Type-check src/common/ through the main, renderer and environment programs by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/351
* Build the main entry for Rolldown's node platform by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/373
* Define `__dirname` and `__filename` in the main bundle, so that a bundled CommonJS package loads in the ESM main, by @dex4er in bd206b2

### Tests

* Click through the extension's views in the integration tests, one session per API version by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/376
* Follow Freelens changes since the 2026-10-12 nightly: React test helpers, CI agent and integration tests by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/382
* Run the integration tests against Freelens dev over CDP by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/383
* Name the URL of a console error, and match the host's getNs() in the test stub by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/400
* Seed the kubeconfig sync of the Freelens dev profile for the integration tests by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/402

### Agent skills and documentation

* Agent skills for creating a Freelens extension and porting one to v2 by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/341
* Document how to check the extension in Freelens dev by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/347
* Add the observer props rule and the monaco-editor devDependency from the fluxcd port by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/360
* Let the CI agent do several steps of a port in one run by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/361
* Take optional fields from the kubebuilder markers when adding an API by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/367
* Fold the findings of the freelens-for-claude-extension port into the template and the skills by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/374
* Fold the findings of the freelens-ai-extension port into the port skill by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/378
* Describe the integration tests as an optional pattern in the skills by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/386
* Move the migration issue template into the port skill by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/388
* Move the port's pin to Freelens 14a491f12 and nightly 2026-10-26 by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/398

### CI and Renovate

* Fix the title of the automated npm audit pull request by @robertobandini in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/325
* Update Biome to 2.5.15 and run biome migrate on the Renovate branch by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/354
* Renovate follows the versions Freelens has on `main`, in one "Freelens dependencies" group; pnpm updates come from the npm registry in pull requests of their own
* Prerelease versions are tagged too, and their GitHub releases are marked as prereleases

## Updates

* Update trunk-io/trunk-action action to v2 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/335

* Update kindest/node Docker tag to v1.37.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/333
* Update dependency electron to v43.7.9 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/337
* Update dependency electron to v44 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/397
* Update dependency @freelensapp/extensions to v2.0.0-0-nightly-2026-10-12 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/365
* Update dependency @freelensapp/extensions to v2.0.0-0-nightly-2026-10-15 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/381
* Update Freelens dependencies by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/358, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/380, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/390 and https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/394

* Update dependency jdx/mise to v2026.10.4, v2026.10.11, v2026.10.13 and v2026.10.19 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/330, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/338, https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/389 and https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/391

latestRelease.name: v2.0.0
latestRelease.body:
The first release of the example extension for the Freelens extension API v2. It needs Freelens 2.0.0 or newer; v1.10.2 stays the release for Freelens 1.x.

The repository is the reference template for building, type-checking, testing and releasing a Freelens v2 extension. The Freelens extension docs (`docs/extensions/` in freelensapp/freelens) define the API contract and point here for the rest; `AGENTS.md` explains every pattern and why it is there.

## Breaking changes

* Requires Freelens `^2.0.0` (`engines.freelens`) and Node.js 24 (`engines.node: >= 24.0.0`).
* `dist/main.js` and `dist/renderer.js` are ES modules (`"type": "module"`), built by two Vite library-mode runs instead of electron-vite. The renderer CSS is extracted to `dist/renderer.css`.
* The stack follows Freelens 2.0.0: React 19.3, mobx 7 with mobx-react 10 (standard decorators only, `@observable accessor`), TypeScript 7, Vite 8, Vitest 5, Electron 44, pnpm 12.

| Library                   | v1.10.2   | v2.0.0 |
| ------------------------- | --------- | ------ |
| `@freelensapp/extensions` | `^1.10.2` | 2.0.0  |
| react, react-dom          | 17.0.2    | 19.3.1 |
| mobx                      | 6.13.7    | 7.0.6  |
| mobx-react                | 7.6.0     | 10.0.2 |
| typescript                | 5.9.3     | 7.0.2  |
| vitest                    | `^4.1.9`  | 5.0.5  |
| node                      | 22        | 24     |
| pnpm                      | 10.34.4   | 12.15.0 |

## What's Changed

### Extension API v2

* Migrate the build stack and shared sources to the Freelens v2 extension API by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/328
* Adapt the Example feature to the Freelens v2 extension API by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/336
* Re-render the available version page when the host serves a version by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/353
* Register the Example models in customResources by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/364
* Register details and menu items with the typed helpers of the extension API by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/368
* Keep a render error of the extension inside its page, panel or menu item by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/370

### Build and type check

* Write the CSS module declarations with a plugin that cannot leave one empty by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/344
* Check for unused files with knip by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/349
* Type-check src/common/ through the main, renderer and environment programs by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/351
* Build the main entry for Rolldown's node platform by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/373
* Define `__dirname` and `__filename` in the main bundle, so that a bundled CommonJS package loads in the ESM main, by @dex4er in bd206b2

### Tests

* Click through the extension's views in the integration tests, one session per API version by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/376
* Follow Freelens changes since the 2026-10-12 nightly: React test helpers, CI agent and integration tests by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/382
* Run the integration tests against Freelens dev over CDP by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/383
* Name the URL of a console error, and match the host's getNs() in the test stub by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/400
* Seed the kubeconfig sync of the Freelens dev profile for the integration tests by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/402

### Agent skills and documentation

* Agent skills for creating a Freelens extension and porting one to v2 by @claude[bot] in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/341
* Document how to check the extension in Freelens dev by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/347
* Add the observer props rule and the monaco-editor devDependency from the fluxcd port by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/360
* Let the CI agent do several steps of a port in one run by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/361
* Take optional fields from the kubebuilder markers when adding an API by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/367
* Fold the findings of the freelens-for-claude-extension port into the template and the skills by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/374
* Fold the findings of the freelens-ai-extension port into the port skill by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/378
* Describe the integration tests as an optional pattern in the skills by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/386
* Move the migration issue template into the port skill by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/388
* Move the port's pin to Freelens 14a491f12 and nightly 2026-10-26 by @dex4er in https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-example-extension/pull/398

### CI and Renovate
